info.title: MDM Syniti Analysis Orchestrator API
info.description:
Enterprise SAP Migration & Data Governance SQL Analysis Engine.
Under Project Rules (see docs/PROJECT_RULES.md), all queries are parsed and synthesized exclusively through the OpenAI Agents SDK and verified domain knowledge.

get.description: Liveness probe. Always returns HTTP 200 while the web process is running.

Readiness probe verifying vector indexes, cache connectivity, and LLM configuration.

Returns HTTP 503 if any check fails (including missing or unconfigured LLM API key).

200.description: All subsystems healthy and ready for traffic.

503.description: One or more subsystems not ready.

get.description: Returns curated SQL examples from the reference workbook for dropdown selection.
Returns current user profile for application navbar and UI shell.

post.description: Creates a migration project. Currently returns 501 Not Implemented.
Streams metadata refresh logs and progress. Currently returns 501 Not Implemented.

get.description: Returns single migration project by ID (PLACEHOLDER UI DATA).
Returns recent analysis activity history (PLACEHOLDER UI DATA).
Returns status of LLM subsystem without contacting provider or leaking API keys.
Returns read-only diagnostics and configuration settings of the LLM pipeline.

post.description:
Executes full analysis pipeline across security guardrails, parsing, multi-tier cache, agents, and synthesizer.

Returns authoritative BusinessIntelligence and Data Governance metadata.

Streams pipeline progress, intermediate events, and final result over Server-Sent Events (SSE).

Client disconnection stops writing without cancelling the shielded background execution.

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream emitting progress, result, and done events.

get.description: Returns detailed multi-tier cache statistics and hit/miss ratios.

delete.description: Clears cache storage across specified tiers (all, l1, l2, l3).

post.description: Executes a 1-token live request to test credentials and connectivity (result cached 60s).

get.description: Lists learned SAP entries derived from grounded retrieval.

post.description: Approves a learned SAP entry for official prebuilt integration and logs audit entry.
Rejects a learned SAP entry and logs audit entry.

get.description: Returns proposed new subject areas, processes, and business concepts for review.
